# ZXH_CF7

## ZXH_CF7: implementation details

[Python formula](../../../../../src/mop_problems/problems/constrained/zxh_cf.py) · [Mathematical definition](../../../../../docs/formulas.md#zxh-cf)

- Decision bounds: `[1e-10, 1e-10, 1e-10, 1e-10, 1e-10, 1e-10, 1e-10, 1e-10, 1e-10, 1e-10, 1e-10, 1e-10, 1e-10]` to `[0.9999999999, 0.9999999999, 0.9999999999, 0.9999999999, 0.9999999999, 0.9999999999, 0.9999999999, 0.9999999999, 0.9999999999, 0.9999999999, 0.9999999999, 0.9999999999, 0.9999999999]` (scalar bounds broadcast to all variables).
- Default parameters: `{"n_var": 13, "n_obj": 3, "k": 2}`.
- Properties: continuous, minimization.
- Derivatives: `forward`; smoothness: `smooth`. [Jacobian contract](../../../../../docs/gradients.md).
- Derivative notes: Smooth formula on the decision box; this does not imply convexity.
- All objectives are minimized; constraints use `G <= 0`, `H = 0`.
- Constraint representation: raw G <= 0, H = 0; box derivatives are not included.
- Notes: ZXH_CF1-16, pinned PlatEMO definitions, box [1e-10,1-1e-10].

```python
from mop_problems import get_problem

problem = get_problem("ZXH_CF7")
result = problem.evaluate(problem.sample(4, seed=42))
print(result.F)
jac = problem.jacobian(problem.sample(1, seed=238))
print(jac.dF.shape)  # (1, n_obj, n_var); see smoothness notes above
```
